arxiv-2001-09686.creator: Stefan Kurz, Sebastian Schöps, Gerhard Unger, Felix Wolf
arxiv-2001-09686.description:
A 2020 arXiv research paper by Stefan Kurz, Sebastian Schöps, Gerhard Unger, Felix Wolf. We solve Maxwell’s eigenvalue problem via isogeometric boundary elements and a contour integral method. We discuss the analytic properties of the discretisation, outline the implementation, and showcase numerical examples. 2010 MSC

arxiv-2407-03970.title: Overdispersion in gate tomography: Experiments and continuous, two-scale random walk model on the Bloch sphere
arxiv-2407-03970.creator: Wolfgang Nowak, Tim Brünnette, Merel Schalkers, Matthias Möller
arxiv-2407-03970.description: Abstract . Noisy intermediate-scale quantum computers (NISQ) are computing hardware in their childhood, but they are showing high promise and growing quickly. They are based on so-called qubits, which are the quantum equivalents of bits. Any given qubit state results in a given probability of observing a value of zero or one in the readout process.

arxiv-2407-21581.title: InScope: A New Real-world 3D Infrastructure-side Collaborative Perception Dataset for Open Traffic Scenarios
arxiv-2407-21581.creator: Xiaofei Zhang, Yining Li, Jinping Wang, Xiangyi Qin, Ying Shen, Zhengping Fan, Xiaojun Tan
arxiv-2407-21581.description: Abstract Perception systems of autonomous vehicles are susceptible to occlusion, especially when examined from a vehicle-centric perspective. Such occlusion can lead to overlooked object detections, e.g., larger vehicles such as trucks or buses may create blind spots where cyclists or pedestrians could be obscured, accentuating the safety concerns associated with such perception system limitations.

arxiv-2411-08927.title: Aspects of Quantum Energy Teleportation
arxiv-2411-08927.creator: Taisanul Haque
arxiv-2411-08927.description: Abstract In this work, we explore quantum energy teleportation (QET) protocols, focusing on their behavior at finite temperatures , in ground and excited states. We analyze the role of entanglement as a resource for QET, particularly in thermal states, and compare the performance of QET across these initial states.

pmc-11444199.title: Exploring General Practitioners’ Knowledge, Attitudes, and Practices towards E-Cigarette Use/Vaping in Children and Adolescents: A Pilot Cross-Sectional Study in Sydney
pmc-11444199.creator: Rajiv Singh, Michael Burke, Susan Towns, Muhammad Aziz Rahman, Renee Bittoun, Smita Shah, Anthony Liu, Habib Bhurawala, Gabriele Grunig, Paul B Tchounwou
pmc-11444199.description: (1) Background: The increasing use of e-cigarettes/vaping in children and adolescents has been recognised as a global health concern. We aim to explore the Knowledge, Attitude, and Practice of General Practitioners (GPs) in Sydney regarding the use of e-cigarettes in children and adolescents and identify the barriers to addressing this issue.

pmc-11531563.title: Unveiling sulfur vacancy pairs as bright and stable color centers in monolayer WS2
pmc-11531563.creator: Huacong Sun, Qing Yang, Jianlin Wang, Mingchao Ding, Mouyang Cheng, Lei Liao, Chen Cai, Zitao Chen, Xudan Huang, Zibing Wang, Zhi Xu, Wenlong Wang, Kaihui Liu, Lei Liu, Xuedong Bai, Ji Chen, Sheng Meng, Lifen Wang
pmc-11531563.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Color centers, arising from zero-dimensional defects, exploit quantum confinement to access internal electron quantum degrees of freedom, holding potential for quantum technologies. Despite intensive research, the structural origin of many color centers remains elusive. In this study, we employ in-situ cathodoluminescence scanning transmission electron microscopy combined with integrated differential phase contrast imaging to examine how defect configuration in tungsten sulfide determines color-center emission.

pmc-11666654.title: Quality management of head and neck patient treatments using statistical process control techniques
pmc-11666654.creator: Michael J Sandford, Jared G Steel, Josie R Goodworth, Patrick J Lodge
pmc-11666654.description: The treatment, planning, simulation, and setup of radiotherapy patients contain many processes subject to errors involving both staff and equipment. Cone-beam-CT (CBCT) provides a final check of patient positioning and corrections based on this can be made prior to treatment delivery. Statistical Process Control (SPC) techniques are used in various industries for quality management and error mitigation.

pmc-12590891.title: Carboxyhemoglobin: a potential participant in neonatal hemolytic jaundice accompanied with myocardial injury
pmc-12590891.creator: Xin Qing, Jimo Zhu, Yu Luo, Binzhi Tang
pmc-12590891.description: Neonatal jaundice is commonly seen in early postnatal days, and a considerable proportion of cases are caused by hemolysis. It has been found that hemolytic jaundice in neonates is often accompanied with myocardial injury, which may pose a threat to their health. However, the pathogenic mechanism remains unclear.

pmc-12603119.title: Sampling design and estimation procedure for energy audit and carbon footprints for onion crop in India
pmc-12603119.creator: Kaustav Aditya, Bharti, Pankaj Das, Rahul Banerjee, A Carolin Rathinakumari, Tauqueer Ahmad, Vinod Kumar Bhargav, G Senthil Kumaran, S A Venu
pmc-12603119.description: Agriculture significantly contributes to greenhouse gas emissions, necessitating swift policy action to mitigate its environmental impact, aligning with UN sustainable development Goals (SDGs). Assessing energy usage and targeting energy-intensive operations are key to effective energy management that enables farmers to implement strategies, reducing costs and carbon footprint.

pmc-12676586.title: MOTOR IMAGERY ENHANCES EARLY REHABILITATION IN PATIENTS WITH HIGH KINESIOPHOBIA AFTER TOTAL KNEE ARTHROPLASTY: A RANDOMIZED CONTROLLED TRIAL
pmc-12676586.creator: Jejeong LEE, Minjeong KIM, Yongwoo LEE
pmc-12676586.description: ObjectiveTo investigate the effects of motor imagery on psychological and physical outcomes during acute-phase rehabilitation following total knee arthroplasty.DesignA single-blind, randomized controlled trial.Subjects/PatientsForty patients who underwent total knee arthroplasty and scored ≥37 on the Tampa Scale of Kinesiophobia were enrolled and randomly allocated to either a motor imagery group or a control group.

pmc-12910309.title: Histopathological Features and Antiviral Efficacy in Patients Over 30 Years Old with Chronic Hepatitis B in the Indeterminate Phase
pmc-12910309.creator: Ke-Ying Ou, Yue-Yang Ma, Chuan-Su Yuan, Yu-Jia Lu, Bin Liu, Jia-nan Cui, Wei-hao Zhao, Yong-Feng Yang, Qing-Fang Xiong
pmc-12910309.description: Background/Aims:There are still many controversies about whether antiviral therapy should be administered to patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) in the indeterminate phase. Thus, this study aimed to investigate the histopathological features and antiviral efficacy of HBeAg-negative CHB patients aged over 30 in the indeterminate phase.

pmc-13224122.title: Biofortification of kale with vitamin B12 and iodine for vegans using a vertical farming system
pmc-13224122.creator: Seul Lee, Mzia Benashvili, Yong-Joon Park, Yixuan Sun, Sun-A Kim, Chae-Ryun Moon, Yang-Ju Son
pmc-13224122.description: Vitamin B12 and iodine deficiencies are significant public health concerns and exhibit greater severity among vegans and vegetarians. This study aimed to evaluate the effects of the multi-biofortification of kale with vitamin B12 and iodine in a hydroponic vertical farming system. During hydroponic cultivation, kale was treated with cyanocobalamin (CN) and KI for a week before harvest.

pmc-13617498.title: Roles of GDF-15 in Acute Heart Failure: from Mechanistic Insights to Clinical Applications
pmc-13617498.creator: Paisit Kosum, Nonthikorn Theerasuwipakorn, Siriporn C Chattipakorn, Nipon Chattipakorn
pmc-13617498.description: Acute heart failure (AHF) is a clinical syndrome characterized by the rapid or gradual onset of symptoms and signs of heart failure that are severe enough to require urgent evaluation and treatment. It may represent de novo heart failure or acute decompensation of pre-existing chronic heart failure.

Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Establishment There is established, under the Oversight Board, the position of the Revitalization Coordinator. (b) Appointment (1) In general The Revitalization Coordinator shall be appointed by the Governor as follows: (A) Prior.
